description: Use this when the user wants an org chart maker, an organizational chart maker, or to create an org chart, a company hierarchy chart or a team structure chart from a reporting list. Give the people (2-500, with who each reports to) or attach a CSV/XLSX file, and it lays out a tidy tree with no overlapping boxes, colours boxes by department or level, and returns downloadable vector SVG and fitted landscape PDF files (Letter, A4, A3 or Tabloid). Limits: name and title cards only (no photos), up to 500 people, automatic layout (no manual dragging); PDF fonts support Latin, Greek and Cyrillic, and unsupported scripts or emoji produce an input error. Do not use for family trees, flowcharts or seating charts.

color_by.description: Box colour: department uses one colour per department (default), level shades boxes by depth, none leaves them white, e.g. level.

file.description: Optional CSV or XLSX file with a header row and one person per row, columns id/name/title/manager/department (matched case-insensitively), e.g. team.csv or org.xlsx.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

orientation.description: Chart direction: top_down puts each manager above their reports (default), left_right puts the manager to the left, e.g. left_right.

paper.description: Landscape PDF page size: letter (default), a4, a3 or tabloid (11x17 in), e.g. a4.

people.description: The people and who they report to, 2-500 records, e.g. [{"name":"Ada Lee","title":"CEO"},{"name":"Ben Cole","manager":"Ada Lee"}]. Give this or attach a file.

department.description: Department label used for colouring, e.g. Engineering.

id.description: Short unique id used to point a manager at this person, e.g. p1 or ada. If omitted, the name is the id.

manager.description: Id or name of the person this one reports to; leave blank for the top person, e.g. ada.

name.description: Full name as it prints in the box, e.g. Ada Lee.

title.description: Job title shown under the name, e.g. VP Engineering.

name: make_org_chart
title: Make an org chart
